messages:
olivia_sales: Heads-up — AcmeHealth procurement says their chargeback requires invoice lines split by cost-center codes (CC-ENG / CC-RESEARCH). They also say their PO system only accepts vendor SKUs that match internal labels, so their PO will reference "Redwood LLM - Research" not our marketplace sku. They want the commit discount to apply if combined spend across both centers hits the tier.
ben_dealdesk: Noted. Marketplace attribution is done at offer_id+sku. If they send two internal labels that don't map to our SKUs, automatic commit recognition will likely fail.
carl_se: We saw this once — marketplace metering won't magically aggregate across unmatched customer labels. Two clean paths: 1) create a Private Offer that exposes SKUs matching their cost centers with a shared commit, or 2) accept PO as-is and perform manual attribution/crediting. Private Offer is cleaner but slower.
maya_finance: Finance preference is Private Offer for auditability, but if they need to start the POC tomorrow finance can approve a one-time manual attribution with conditions: signed buyer acknowledgement, credit cap, and a 45-day claim window. Accounting needs GL codes up-front.
olivia_sales: Customer wants to start immediately and can't change their PO template before month-end. They asked if we can accept their PO referencing internal labels and still honor the commit.
marketplace-bot: FYI: Provider marketplace behavior varies. AWS supports multiple sku entries under the same offer, Azure may support usage-dimensions. Private Offer creation requires partner config + review; ETA 48-72h after deal desk approval.
ben_dealdesk: Draft exception language: "Redwood will accept PO referencing customer internal labels and will manually attribute usage to the agreed marketplace SKUs for the period May 2026. If marketplace metering does not map charges, Redwood will issue a one-time credit up to $XX,XXX within 45 days following invoice, upon receipt of a signed buyer acknowledgement." Needs legal + finance sign-off.
legal-bot: Legal check: require signed acknowledgement, cap on credits, 45-day audit window, and right to audit usage before issuing credit. Recommend specifying GL codes and ledger instructions.
maya_finance: GL codes: REV_MARKETPLACE_01 for revenue, CREDIT_RETRO_01 for manual credits. Accounting will only process credits with signed ack attached.
carl_se: SKU mapping snippet for accounting (paste into billing ticket):
```
offer_id: offer_aws_acme_01
marketplace_skus: 
  - redwood.acme.research
  - redwood.acme.eng
customer_labels: 
  - "Redwood LLM - Research"
  - "Redwood LLM - Eng"
mapping_notes: combine both skus towards monthly commit of 300k tokens/month for May 2026
```
ben_dealdesk: I'll send this draft to legal + finance now. If legal approves, deal desk can authorize one-time manual attribution and we accept the PO today. If legal declines, we escalate to Private Offer flow.
olivia_sales: I'll tell the buyer we're targeting same-day acceptance pending approvals. They can sign the acknowledgement immediately.
legal-bot: Legal approved with edits: add a 30-day maximum for retro credits (preferred) but finance already required 45 days. Legal accepts 45 days if credit cap included and customer ack signed. Updated clause posted to thread.
maya_finance: Finance accepts 45-day window and confirms credit cap at $20,000 for this POC. Accounting requests a copy of the signed buyer acknowledgment before any credit is applied.
ben_dealdesk: Deal desk approves one-time manual attribution with the agreed cap and 45-day window. Recording approvals: ben_dealdesk, maya_finance, legal. Action items: 1) olivia_sales upload signed PO + ack, 2) carl_se add mapping to billing ticket, 3) maya_finance create accounting memo with GL codes.
olivia_sales: Buyer uploaded signed PO and signed acknowledgement PDF. Starting POC now. I'll attach docs to the SFDC opportunity. Thanks team. :tada:
carl_se: Added mapping and notes to billing ticket. Will monitor the first marketplace invoice and prepare to trigger credit if metering fails.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: If private-offer path is later requested, marketplace provisioning will lock the current ratecard for that offer and may require amendment for changes.
ben_dealdesk: Closing note: this was approved as a one-off exception; do not reuse language for future deals without bilateral approval. Logging this resolution in the deal notes and tagging policy for review.
olivia_sales: Thanks all — POC kicked off. Please ping if anything shows up on the invoice. :shipit:
